acquisition_counter_rx.description: Saturating counter of media lane acquisitions after commissioning the relevant DP or NP: automatically reset when the associated DPSM (or NPSM) enters the DPInit (or NPInit) state, incremented when the media lane receiver declares lock to the incoming signal. Advertisement: 60h:130.7.
